text: You start on a mini raft. Here, you are given a situation, then you make your choice.
There will, however, be sacrifices most of the time. Of course, everything comes with a price.
You want to relax, easing into your journey, what do you decide to do?

choices.label: Watch the stars, noting the beautiful colours
Lean over the edge and run your hand through the water
Take a nap, enjoying the breeze

text: You check your supplies, seeing what you can do to keep you busy.

choices.label: Illuminate your walls with your star lights
Make your boat more homey and comfortable

text: You decide to go fishing for stars, what do you do?

Look for the one that shines the brightest, then try to swipe it as you pass by it
